entities.summary: Michael Wayne Huff II is an American former professional football player who was a safety in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Texas Longhorns and then played 8 years in the NFL, primarily with the Oakland Raiders, who had drafted him with the seventh overall pick in the 2006 NFL draft. At Texas, he won a national championship and was recognized as a unanimous All-American and the top college defensive back. In the NFL, he was second-team All-Pro in 2010. In his last NFL season, he played briefly for both the Baltimore Ravens and the Denver Broncos.
